findings.message: Supported evidence permits public storage access.
findings.suggestion: Remove public grants or enforce the applicable public-access restriction.

findings.message: Supported evidence permits broad inbound administrative access.
findings.suggestion: Restrict sources and require a controlled administrative access path.

findings.message: An active long-lived key exceeds the configured age threshold.
findings.suggestion: Rotate the key through the authorized credential workflow.

findings.message: A privileged identity has effective MFA disabled.
findings.suggestion: Enforce MFA through the supported identity policy.

findings.message: A required audit-logging category is disabled.
findings.suggestion: Enable the documented required audit categories.
